title: Symmetrical Transmission
description: An automated satellite receives a string of characters from a deep space probe. Due to cosmic interference, symbols are scattered, but the mission control engineers suspect the core message is a symmetrical sequence when ignoring all non-alphanumeric characters and treating uppercase and lowercase letters identically. Write a function that determines if the cleaned transmission reads the same forward and backward.
constraints: s consists only of printable ASCII characters.
input_format: A string s representing the received satellite transmission.
output_format: A boolean value (true or false) indicating whether the transmission is a valid palindrome.

examples.input: s = "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"

examples.explanation: An empty string or a string with only non-alphanumeric characters reads the same forward and backward.
